method: WebSearch + WebFetch of each page marked page_read=true. Scores: subjective components are estimates by the research lead; no engagement or growth data were measured.

candidates.title: Adaptive aging hypothesis: brain trades episodic detail for meaning
candidates.publisher: ScienceDaily (Association for Psychological Science release; University of Arizona)
candidates.claim: Theory paper (Fernandez, Burke, Nadel, Perspectives on Psychological Science, DOI 10.1177/17456916261469175) proposes age-related shift from hippocampal detail to frontal 'gist/meaning' may be developmental adaptation, not only decline; disrupted in Alzheimer's.

lenses.verification: Hypothesis/framework paper, not a new experiment; press-release level summary read, original paper not read. Must be framed as a proposal, not a finding.
lenses.audience_psychology: Strong: everyone has an ageing parent; reframes fear of forgetting into meaning. Identity and legacy themes.
lenses.brand_fit: Fits philosophy/psychology pillar; bridges to 'what to keep vs what to drop' thinking strategists like.

candidates.note: SELECTED R1 (paired with C02 as converging evidence)

candidates.title: Older adults tell life stories with more general knowledge
candidates.claim: Psychology and Aging (Melega ... Renoult, UEA): 37 older vs 37 younger adults; older adults' memories had more semantic/general detail (e.g. 40-42% vs 15-24% in categoric memories), rated specific memories more vivid; senior author argues style may be adaptive. Small, not preregistered, mostly female.

lenses.verification: Secondary report read in full; original paper not read. Small sample, not preregistered; use as illustration, not proof.
lenses.audience_psychology: Concrete: 'older people talk longer and add context' is recognisable daily experience.

candidates.title: Apple Music new identity 'made by sound'

lenses.verification: Three independent outlets read (Wallpaper*, MacRumors, AppleInsider) agree on process; colour shift to black/white reported only by MacRumors -> attribute it. Apple newsroom page not located.
lenses.audience_psychology: Curiosity gap: a logo 'made by sound'. Tension between brand as fixed mark vs brand as behaviour.
lenses.brand_fit: Strong for brand/visual strategy pillar; lesson transferable to small brands: derive identity from what you actually make.

candidates.title: Moral framing of meat-shaming increases defensiveness
candidates.claim: PSPB, two preregistered UK experiments (n=307, n=316): moral critiques triggered more defensiveness than competence critiques; private DMs more defensive than public comments; no critique increased intention to cut meat.

lenses.brand_fit: Bridge to brand messaging possible; topic (meat) is polarising and weak concrete image for the brand.

candidates.note: not selected; possible future persuasion piece

story_gate.R1: C01+C02: tension 'we call it forgetting; it may be distilling'; image: an elder who forgets the date but remembers the lesson. Beats C07 (persuasion) and C08 (loneliness) on originality and concreteness.
story_gate.R2: C03-C05: tension 'a logo is something you draw vs. something your product makes'; image: music rippling a tank of oil until the logo appears. Beats C06 (overlaps yesterday) and C10 (stale).
